capabilities: Trigger navigation with right-click mouse gestures
Switch to next and previous documents with left/right gestures
Scroll to the top or bottom of a document with up/down gestures
Draw an on-screen visual overlay tracking the gesture
Assign built-in actions or custom command IDs to each gesture
extras: Diagonal gestures are off by default, require the Modern (v2) gesture engine, and must be drawn as a single straight stroke; two-step gestures remain available but combinations containing a diagonal are not supported.
intentEvidence: The default mappings follow Mouse Gesture Events
problem: Obsidian navigation relies on keyboard shortcuts and clicks; it has no built-in way to trigger navigation actions with mouse movements.

relations.evidence: The default mappings follow Mouse Gesture Events

summary: Right-click mouse gesture plugin that navigates between documents, scrolls, and runs assignable Obsidian commands via drawn mouse strokes.
